card.name: Small words in general web prose
card.fires_on: Short everyday words such as you, into, over, in, hold and Year in general web text, often inside an address to the reader or a catalog entry. It is not found in drug-label text.

modes.label: Addressing the reader
modes.description: Pronouns or verbs in direct invitations and instructions to the reader.
modes.example: Each of<< you>> should have an account on this machine.

modes.label: Short prepositions after verbs or nouns
modes.description: Words like into, over or in that follow a verb or role word in casual prose.
modes.example: Without further commentary, let's jump<< into>> this.

modes.label: Catalog field labels
modes.description: The word Year in a Publication Year field of a book listing.
modes.example: America in the Age of the Titans The Progressive Era and World War I Publication<< Year>>: 1988 Detail

card.plain: It marks small everyday words in ordinary web writing, such as talking to the reader or book listings.
